note: Analyst reading of the news, written by the weekly agent from logged events. Not data. Replace every week.
headline: Attacks on shipping are at a record: UKMTO counted 10-12 in the week to Oct 16, and the container ship GFS Pride sank on Oct 13 (#109). The US has not answered them with strikes on Iran.

Trump pledged on Oct 8 that the US 'will not be attacking Iran at any time prior to' the Nov 3 midterms (#97). CBS reports strike plans are ready (#111) and Trump has said action could resume after the midterms (#82, #88).
Talks are live: Iran says it is reviewing US 'comments' and that Hormuz would reopen on the sixth day if the US complies (#115). The US counter-offer went through Qatar on Sep 29 (#86).
Sanctions rounds keep coming roughly weekly (Sep 28, Oct 1, Oct 8, Oct 15), and the US disabled a blockade runner on Oct 10-11 (#104).
